live.label: Live (out of sample)
live.note: Plans written by the scheduled GitHub job before 09:15 IST and committed publicly, scored against official NSE data.

unverified.note: Plans made outside the scheduled job (for example on a laptop) or after the open. Their timing cannot be checked, so they are scored but kept out of the live record.

backtest.label: Backtest (not live)
backtest.note: The same code replayed over past sessions using only data available on each day. Caveats: today's Nifty 50 members only (survivorship bias); plan outcomes use daily bars with conservative fills; prices are adjusted for later corporate actions.
